This plan provides maximum coverage including personal accident benefits.
productRecommendation.reasonComprehensiveDefault: Comprehensive coverage provides complete protection with maximum coverage for your {{vehicleDescription}}. Perfect for ensuring peace of mind with protection against all major risks including natural disasters and personal accident benefits.

productRecommendation.defaultReasonComprehensive: Maximum protection for peace of mind. Comprehensive coverage protects against all major risks including natural disasters and provides additional benefits for you and your passengers.

productRiskMapping.riskSectionsHelp: An IAR policy is made of many independent sections. Define which sections this product offers. Risk location, perils and sums insured are captured per section when quoting.
productRiskMapping.confirmRemove: Remove section {{name}}? It will be deactivated (soft delete).
productRiskMapping.deferredIntro: This is a prototype of Industrial All Risks, not the specification. A production IAR product still needs:
productRiskMapping.deferredTailoredBody: Sections are generic here — every section has the same fields. Motor, Marine and PA sections need their own.
productRiskMapping.deferredMeasureBody: A peril's cover is a plain typed sum insured — no per-occurrence / aggregate / first-loss distinction.
productRiskMapping.deferredPremiumBody: Typed once at policy level. There is no rate × sum-insured calculation, and none is implied.
productRiskMapping.deferredBindingBody: A quote can add any section; this definition does not constrain it yet.
productRiskMapping.deferredCommissionBody: Out of scope — commission is one blended line on the policy premium.
productRiskMapping.genericHelp: Definition: {{definition}}. Configuration for this LOB will be defined here and integrated into create-prospect later.
productRiskMapping.notIntegrated: Not integrated into create-prospect / quote flows yet.

periodEnd.periodManagementHelp: Fiscal years and their accounting periods. Soft-closed periods accept postings from Accounting Managers only; closed periods accept none; periods of a closed fiscal year are locked.
periodEnd.monthEndCloseHelp: One close run per period: accruals, recurring journals, commission deferral, FX revaluation and the checklist, then a close approved by a second user.
periodEnd.yearEndHelp: Closes income and expense to current year profit or loss and then to retained earnings in adjustment period 13, carries the balance-sheet balances into the next fiscal year and locks the year.
periodEnd.recurringHelp: Recurring templates are posted on their next run date (recurring-journals job or month-end close); accrual templates are posted at the period end by the month-end close and reversed on day 1 of the next period.
periodEnd.checklistHelp: Items copied to every month-end close run. Automatic items run a built-in check; manual items are signed off by a user. Blocking items must pass or be signed off before a period closes.
periodEnd.taxCodesHelp: VAT, expanded and final withholding (with the BIR ATC), documentary stamp, local government and premium taxes, with the GL account each is booked to. Verify rates and ATCs against the current BIR regulations.
periodEnd.statementsHelp: Income statement with year to date and prior year, balance sheet with the prior year end, and the trial balance with opening, movement and closing balances.
periodEnd.bir2307Help: Certificates of creditable tax withheld at source per payee and quarter: tax the broker withheld on payment vouchers (issued) or tax insurers and clients withheld from the broker (received).
periodEnd.reopenHelp: Reopening needs the Accounting Manager's approval permission and a reason. Postings will be accepted again.
periodEnd.closeHelp: The blocking month-end checks run first (unposted journals, trial balance, suspense account). Use a month-end close run for the full checklist.
periodEnd.noRuns: No month-end close runs for this fiscal year
periodEnd.approved: Close approved; the period is closed

stepHelp.deferral: Unearned commission for cover after the period end (when accounting.defer_commission is on).
stepHelp.fx: Foreign-currency balances at the month-end rate of the Exchange Rate master.
stepHelp.checks: Automatic checks of the close checklist.

periodEnd.submitHelp: When approval is required, an Accounting Manager other than you approves the close.
periodEnd.openingBalancesHelp: Written when the year is closed
periodEnd.reverseHelp: The closing entries are reversed, the opening balances removed and the periods unlocked. Possible until the first period of the next year is closed.
periodEnd.adjustmentHelp: Posted in adjustment period 13 (dated the fiscal year end) after approval by a second user.
periodEnd.name: Name
periodEnd.autoReverseHelp: Reverse on day 1 of the next period (accruals)

postingRules.title: Posting Rules
postingRules.intro: Every journal the system posts is built from the posting rule of its business event. Pick an event to see the rule in force, simulate the journal it builds, or save a new version effective from a date.
postingRules.pickEvent: Select a business event to view its posting rule.
postingRules.accountDeterminationIntro: The GL account behind every account role the posting rules use, the payable account per payee type, the cash account per payment mode and the write-off reasons. What this screen shows is what posting uses.
postingRules.taxesSplit: VAT, DST and LGT on premium are booked in their own accounts
postingRules.taxesNotSplit: Premium taxes are booked with the premium due to insurers

commissionTaxes.title: Commission taxes
commissionTaxes.intro: Broker-billed policies: the output VAT on the brokerage commission and the expanded withholding tax the insurer withholds on it, booked when the premium is billed, as on direct-bill commission. The premium due to the insurer is reduced by the VAT and increased by the EWT. Rates, ATC and GL accounts come from the tax codes master; a code without a GL account posts to the account role shown.
commissionTaxes.inactiveCode: A selected tax code is missing or inactive: nothing is booked for it until an active code is chosen.

postingRules.versionPending: Version {{version}} saved; it is used for posting once a second user approves it (Configuration Approvals)
postingRules.changePending: Change saved for approval; it takes effect once a second user approves it (Configuration Approvals)
postingRules.approvalsIntro: Posting rule versions, their activation and account determination changes wait here for a second user with approval rights (Accounting Manager or System Administrator). The requester cannot approve their own change; nothing reaches the ledger before approval.

flow.title: Accounting Flow
flow.intro: What each operational event posts, read from the posting rules in force on {{date}}: the screen or action that triggers it, the approval before it posts, and the accounts it debits and credits. It changes as soon as an approved posting rule or account determination change takes effect.

bankReconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
bankReconciliation.workspaceHelp: Match the bank statement lines with the book entries of the bank account's GL cash account, post the bank items not yet in the books, then prepare the reconciliation for approval.
bankReconciliation.reconciliationsHelp: One reconciliation per bank account and period: draft, prepared by finance, approved by a finance manager (a different user).
bankReconciliation.setupHelp: Link the bank account to the GL cash-in-bank account its receipts and payments post to, and choose the default statement format of the bank's export.
bankReconciliation.notLinkedHelp: Bank account {{account}} is not linked to a GL cash account yet.
bankReconciliation.reconcileFromHelp: Book entries before this date are covered by the first statement's opening balance (empty: the first statement's start date).
bankReconciliation.flagHelp: A bank error is a reconciling item on the bank side (the bank will correct it); no journal is posted.
bankReconciliation.unmatchHelp: The match is kept in the audit trail as undone, with your name and the reason.
bankReconciliation.differenceHelp: Bank {{bank}} and books {{book}} differ by {{difference}}. Explain the difference to match.
bankReconciliation.fromFileOrPrevious: From the file or the previous statement
bankReconciliation.skipDuplicates: Leave out lines already on file
bankReconciliation.balanced: Opening balance + credits - debits = closing balance: the statement balances.

bankReconciliation.duplicatesFound: {{count}} line(s) are already on file for this account (duplicates).
bankReconciliation.receipt: Official receipt of the returned cheque
bankReconciliation.returnedChequeHelp: The receipt is cancelled: its journals are reversed and the receivable is re-opened; the reversal is matched to this bank line.
bankReconciliation.staleHelp: Payments recorded in the books that have not cleared the bank within the stale period. Cancelling a cheque reverses its payment journal and re-opens the payable.
bankReconciliation.staleReasonPlaceholder: Not presented within the stale period
bankReconciliation.noStatementHelp: No bank statement covers this period yet: import the statement before preparing the reconciliation.
bankReconciliation.addUnbookedCredits: Add: bank credits not yet booked
bankReconciliation.lessUnbookedDebits: Less: bank charges not yet booked

dialogHelp.approve: Approving locks every match cleared up to the period end. You cannot approve a reconciliation you prepared.
dialogHelp.reopen: The reconciliation returns to draft and its matches are unlocked. Remarks are required and recorded.
dialogHelp.cancel: The draft reconciliation is cancelled; matches are kept.

bankReconciliation.formatsHelp: How each bank's statement export is read: column mapping, date format, title rows and amount sign. Formats marked Example follow typical layouts; check them against the bank's actual file.

bankReconciliation.columnMappingHelp: Header text of each column (alternatives separated by |) or its column number. Map debit and credit, or one signed amount.
bankReconciliation.typesHelp: Bank items not yet in the books and the journal their adjustment posts: account role or GL account, approval, and the description pattern that suggests the type on imported lines.
bankReconciliation.matchRulesHelp: Applied in this order, exact amounts only. The date window defaults to the bank_reconciliation.date_window_days setting.

privacy.anonymiseRefused: The personal data must be kept for now:
privacy.retentionNote: Last policy expiry {{expiry}}; records are kept {{years}} years, until {{until}}.
privacy.nothingToClear: No personal data left to clear
privacy.keptNote: Policy, receipt and claim numbers, amounts and dates are kept for the books.
privacy.checking: Checking the records of the party...
privacy.outcomeHint: What was done and told to the data subject
privacy.registerIntro: Consents given, refused and withdrawn by clients and prospects. Consents are recorded on the client and prospect screens.
privacy.searchParty: Client or prospect name or code

listCommon.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded: {{message}}

goLiveData.title: Go-Live Data Load
goLiveData.lockedHint: Go-live is locked: the migration workbook can no longer be loaded
goLiveData.confirmLoad: Load the {{valid}} valid rows of batch {{id}} in one transaction?
goLiveData.confirmLoadPartial: Load the {{valid}} valid rows of batch {{id}} and leave the {{errors}} rows with errors out?
goLiveData.passwordsTitle: Temporary passwords of the new users
goLiveData.passwordsOnce: Shown once and not stored. Hand each password to its user privately; it must be changed at the first sign-in.
goLiveData.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
goLiveData.loadFailed: Could not load the go-live data

integrations.monitorIntro: Connections to SMS gateways, the CTPL authentication provider, the LTO, insurer systems and banks: mode, credentials, messages waiting, failed or received.
integrations.templatesIntro: SMS and Viber texts sent to clients: renewal notices, payment reminders, claim updates. Placeholders are filled when the message is sent.
integrations.insurerIntro: How each insurer's system is called: connector, codes and field mapping, the requests sent and the claim status file.
integrations.ctplIntro: Certificates of cover of CTPL policies: COC number, authentication code from the IC-accredited provider, and the covers still waiting.
integrations.layoutsIntro: How each bank's bulk credit, InstaPay or PESONet file is written and its payment status file read; the bank accounts of the payees.
integrations.batchesIntro: Payment vouchers paid by a bank upload file: approval, the file for the bank portal, and the bank's results that post each payment.
integrations.credentialsHelp: Enter the NAME of the environment variable (secret store) that holds each credential, never the value itself. A green tag means the variable is set on the server.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.searchMessages: Search reference, provider reference or error
integrations.testHelp: The template is sent with example values, without the consent check, through its connector (in test mode nothing leaves the system).
integrations.searchCtpl: Search policy, COC, plate, insured or code
integrations.enterCode: Enter code from the provider portal
integrations.manualHelp: Use this when the COC was authenticated on the provider's portal: the code is stored and printed like one received by the system.
integrations.cocFromSeries: Empty: next number of the insurer's series
integrations.autoIssue: Send the issuance request when a policy is issued
integrations.mapHelp: Each map lists target field: source. A source is a path in the policy (insuredName, vehicle.plateNumber), a {{template}} or =literal. An empty request map uses the default.
integrations.previewPolicy: Policy number to preview the request
integrations.forceIssue: Send again although the insurer policy number is known
integrations.claimFileHelp: CSV file from the insurer with the columns Claim Number, Status, Remarks and Status Date. Statuses are read through the insurer's claim status map. Premium and policy data by file: use the insurer statement import.
integrations.statusFileHelp: How the bank's payment status file is read: format, delimiter, skipRows, hasHeader, columns (reference, status, bankReference, reason, amount: header text, column number or start and width), paidValues and rejectedValues.
integrations.exampleLayout: Starter layout: validate it against the bank's current file specification (and a test file accepted by the bank) before paying with it.
integrations.notifyEmail: E-mail for the bank's credit advice
integrations.noVouchers: No payment voucher is waiting for payment

maps.productMap: Product codes (line or product type: insurer code)
maps.responseMap: Answer map (field: path in the answer)

payeeIdHelp.Agent/Referrer: Referrer id (as on the referrer account)
